```{r, echo = TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

# Graph 1 

# Data A
```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_a <- data.frame(
  Category = c("High level of influence on decisions",
                "Learning new things",
                "Use of skills at work",
                "Work recognized and appreciated by management",
               "Receiving help and support from colleagues"),
  `Bank employees` = c(38.96, 28.88, 38.56,22.40, 55.21),
  `Police officers` = c(52, 62, 61.20, 33.70, 67.20),
  `Nursing professionals` = c(39.60, 58.50, 69.20, 26, 60.30)
)
```


# Data A - In long format
```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_long <- pivot_longer(
  data_a,
  cols = -Category,
  names_to = "Profissao",
  values_to = "Percentual"
)
```

```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_long_a <- data_long %>% 
  mutate(Group =  case_when(Profissao == "Bank.employees" ~"Bank employees",
                               Profissao == "Police.officers" ~"Police officers",
                               Profissao == "Nursing.professionals" ~"Nurses"))
```

# Barplot - Data A
```{r, echo = TRUE}

g1 <- ggplot(data_long_a,
       aes(x = Category,
           y = Percentual,
           fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.8) +
   geom_text(aes(label = Percentual),
            hjust = 1,
            size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Group) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100 ),
    labels = c("0", "25", "50", "75", "100")
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greys")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,100)) + coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Protective working conditions", 
       y = NULL,
       x = NULL ) +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = -1.3,
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    )
  )

g1+ theme_dark()
```

# Data B
```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_b <- data.frame(

                "Fast pace",

  `Police officers` = c(33.60, 46.60, 75.60, 12.40, 74.80, 43.20, 69.60,21.60),
  `Nursing professionals` = c(43.50, 68.40, 46.80, 23.00, 81.60, 48.10, 63.60, 52.50)
)
```


# Barplot - Data B
```{r, echo = TRUE}
g2 <- ggplot(data_long_b,
       aes(x = Category,
           y = Percentual,
           fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.8) +
```

# Graph 1
```{r, echo = TRUE}
library(patchwork)

ajuste_padrao <- theme(
  plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0)
)

g1 <- g1 + theme_dark() + ajuste_padrao + theme(legend.position = "none") 

g2 <- g2 + theme_dark() + ajuste_padrao + theme(legend.position = "none")


# Montagem com alturas iguais
p1 <- (g1 ) / (g2 )  +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) 

p1

ggsave("graph_1.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```

# Graph 2

# Data C
```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_c <- data.frame(
  Category = as.factor(c("Use of psychotropic medications",
                "Continuous use > 3 years",
                "Self-medication",
                "Family member or colleague expressed concern about the use",
               "Withdrawal symptoms",
               "Symptoms of tolerance",
               "Feelings of guilt or shame",
               "Attempt to stop on one's own")),
  `Bank employees` = c(71.80, 34.20, 3.40, 68.81,74.31,37.40,56.10,53.30),
  `Police officers` = c(39.69, 26.80, 18.50, 40.70, 55.80, 12.70, 41.40, 55.80),
  `Nursing professionals` = c(52.32, 27.90, 7.60, 33.20, 54.10, 7.30, 23.80,28.40)
)
```


# Data C - In long format
```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_long_3 <- pivot_longer(
  data_c,
  cols = -Category,
  names_to = "Profissao",
  values_to = "Percentual"
)
```

```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_long_c <- data_long_3 %>% 
  mutate(Group =  case_when(Profissao == "Bank.employees" ~"Bank employees",
                               Profissao == "Police.officers" ~"Police officers",
                               Profissao == "Nursing.professionals" ~"Nurses"))
```

# Defining the display order in the plot: Since we are using `coord_flip()`, we need to set the `Category` levels in the reverse order of how you want them to appear in the plot.
```{r, echo = TRUE}
data_long_c$Category <- factor(
  data_long_c$Category,
  levels = c(
    "Attempt to stop on one's own",
    "Feelings of guilt or shame",
    "Symptoms of tolerance",
    "Withdrawal symptoms",
    "Family member or colleague expressed concern about the use",
    "Self-medication",
    "Continuous use > 3 years",
    "Use of psychotropic medications"
  )
)
```


# Barplot - Data C
```{r, echo = TRUE}
g3 <- ggplot(data_long_c,
       aes(x = Category,
           y = Percentual,
           fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
   geom_text(aes(label = Percentual),
            hjust = 0,
            size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Group) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100 ),
    labels = c("0", "25", "50", "75", "100")
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greys")+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,100)) + coord_flip() +
  labs(title = NULL, 
       y = "Percentage (%)",
       x = NULL ) +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    )
  )

g3 + theme_dark()

ggsave("graph_2.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
